sections.title: Sound of a
paragraphs: The letter name is (a) /a/. Its main sound is a vowel, which is a sound made with open air. You hear it in (ami) /a.mi/, which means friend. This letter has two sounds.

sections.title: Saying the letter
paragraphs: For the first sound, open your mouth wide. Keep your tongue flat and forward, near your bottom teeth. For the second sound, open your mouth wide. Pull your tongue slightly back into the mouth. Put a finger before your lips to feel the steady warm air.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: The usual sound is front, as in (ami) /a.mi/. A grave accent mark keeps this sound, as in (là) /la/. A circumflex accent mark gives a back sound, as in (pâte) /pɑt/. You also hear this back sound in (âne) /ɑn/.

sections.title: Common pitfalls
paragraphs: Do not make a diphthong, which is two vowel sounds gliding together. Keep your mouth still so you do not say the vowel in cat. Do not round your lips like the vowel in hot.
